### About this repository

This is the home of the Legesher engine: the translation core, the language packs, the command line, the language server, and the VS Code extension. Every language pack is experimental for now, and community review is how a pack becomes official, so feedback from people who speak these languages is especially welcome.

Looking for a place to start? The [`good first issue`](https://github.com/legesher/legesher/labels/good%20first%20issue) label marks work scoped for someone new, and [Ways to contribute](https://github.com/legesher/legesher/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ways-to-contribute) lists every path in. Most of them need no Python at all.
